# Data Source: tfe_registry_provider

Gets a public or private provider from the private registry.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe.data_tfe_registry_provider.DataTfeRegistryProvider(self, "example",
            name="my-provider",
            organization="my-org-name"
        )
```

            name="aws",
            namespace="hashicorp",
            organization="my-org-name",
            registry_name="public"
        )

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the provider.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the provider. Required if `registry_name` is `public`. For private providers this is the same as the `organization`.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `registry_name` (String) Whether this is a publicly maintained provider or private. Must be either `public` or `private`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time when the provider was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the provider.
- `updated_at` (String) The time when the provider was last updated.
